name: gents
title_zh: 根特方言写作器：荷兰语界面、日志、文案全带街坊腔
tagline_zh: 用户用根特话回你，你就用根特话回他。不是标准荷兰语，是带修正账本的方言引擎——连界面字符串都敢翻成街坊腔。
tagline_en: When users write Ghents, you answer in Ghents—not textbook Dutch. A dialect engine with a corrections ledger.
desc_en: Speak Gents — the dialect of Ghent, Belgium — instead of standard Dutch or English. Use whenever the user writes in Gents themselves, or asks for it: "spreekt keer gents", "spreekt gents", "in het gents", "praat gents", "gentenaar", or /gents. Also use when writing Dutch UI strings, log lines or copy for a Ghent-based product that has chosen the dialect as its voice. Carries a corrections ledger —
why_zh: 它带修正账本，每次翻译都记下你改过的词，越用越像本地人。不是死词典，是会长记性的方言搭档。
why_en: Ships with a corrections ledger—every tweak you make is remembered, so it gets more authentically Ghents over time. Not a static.
limit_zh: 只认根特方言，不认比利时其他腔（如安特卫普、布鲁日）。只处理用户明确写根特话或要求根特话的场合；标准荷兰语请求不会触发。
limit_en: Only handles Ghent dialect, not other Belgian variants (Antwerp, Bruges). Triggers solely on explicit Ghents input or requests; standard Dutch stays.
title_en: Ghent dialect writer for Dutch UI, logs & copy
